Name: Crop Transplant Mod
Author: Digus
Description:
[size=3][b]Current version: [/b]1.3.3[/size]
[list]
[*]Fixing manifest to removing MFM dependency.
[*] Adding french language - Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/745980]Caranud[/url]﻿
[*]Fixing compatibility with mods that make bushs "passable"
[/list][b]
[size=3]Objective: [/size][/b]
To provide ways to change your crops location.
To provide a way to transplant trees.
To provide a way to transplant tea bushes.

[size=3][b]Disclaimer: [/b][/size]
When holding a fully grown tree, it can be drawn under some elements as the game engine never expected for the player to hold item that tall. Near some map elements like fences, the base of the trunk can be drawn over the top parts. If you think this breaks you immersion, try to avoid passing through areas that will trigger this bugs, or don't enable full grown tree transplant.

[size=3][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
This mod might conflict with other mods using harmony or changing the behavior of the toolbar/inventory.

[size=3][b]Update:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Fixed a typo in the config property 'GetGradenPotEarlier', it's now properly named 'GetGardenPotEarlier', so you have to adjust that again if you changed it.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=2][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2594/]Unzip the Crop Transplant Mod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536/]Unzip the MailFrameworkMod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]How does it work[/b]:
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]You will receive a letter from Evelyn explaining the basic rules of crop transplant.[/size]
[*][size=2]The letter is just for flavor though, once you install the mod it should[/size][size=2] already be working.[/size]
[*][size=2]To transplant a crop, hold a garden pot and get close to it. Click with the mouse cursor over the crop and it will be placed inside the pot.[/size]
[*][size=2]You can't be holding a stack of garden pots, there needs to be only one in the toolbar spot you are using.[/size]
[*][size=2]Fertilizer go with the crop. That also means you can't change the fertilizer using transplanting.[/size]
[*][size=2]You can place the pot anywhere you normally would. But if you click on a empty hoed tile, the crop will be transplanted there.[/size]
[*][size=2]You can also lift a pot directly from the ground, but you need to select an empty toolbar spot. The hand icon will show over the pot indicating you can lift it.[/size]
[*][size=2]Lifting any crop from the ground will spent 4 energy points. This number decrees as you level up the farming skill. You can change this value in the config file.[/size]
[*][size=2]If you are holding a crop in the pot and change the active item in the tool bar, the crop will be destroyed. [/size]
[*][size=2]Regular trees that are not fully grown can be transplanted with Garden Pot.[/size]
[*][size=2]They can be placed the same places you would be able to plant a seed.[/size]
[*][size=2]You can change max stage, valid tiles and energy cost per stage on the config file, for regular trees.[/size]
[*][size=2]Fruit trees up until the 3th stage can be transplanted with the Garden Pot.[/size]
[*][size=2]They can be placed the same places you would be able to plant a sapling.[/size]
[*][size=2]You can change max stage, valid tiles, tree proximity restriction, out of the farm restriction and ﻿e[/size][size=2][size=2]nergy cost per stage on the config file, for fruit trees.[/size][/size]
[*][size=2][size=2]Energy cost for lifting any tree type will [size=2]decrees as you level up the foraging skill[/size].[/size][/size]
[*][size=2][size=2]Regular trees now have a soil tile under them, when not on grass or ﻿'diggable' tile. This can be disabled. [/size][/size]
[*][size=2][size=2]Tea Bushes can be transplanted with the Garden Pot.[/size][/size]
[*][size=2][size=2]Tea Bushes planted in pots can also be lifted.[/size][/size]
[*][size=2][size=2]They cost the same energy to move as crops, and the energy is also decrease with farm skill level.[/size][/size]
[*][size=2][size=2]Lifted Tea Bushes will always be planted on the ground if possible, other wise the pot will be placed on the ground is possible.[/size][/size]
[*][size=2][size=2]You can enable in the config file to plant Tea Bushes outside the farm, and also to plant them on any tile without restriction.[/size][/size]
[/list]
